what: Calibrate once with the headset resting at the center of the long edge opposite the arms. Optional drift correction uses the flush silver screws on the two black bases.
why: Keep the short mixed reality demo steady by default and allow marker-free recovery during longer rehearsals.
details: The XR top and corner survey now use 96 by 28 inches. The launcher starts the watcher only with --drift-correction. The initial dock works without the camera; teaching or measuring the headset shell offset makes it repeatable. The image pipeline passed 72 simulated screw views. A real bench test under demo lighting remains open.
